BEGIN;

-- Deduplicate compose_config by config payload.
WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
UPDATE course_version cv
SET compose_config_id = m.canonical_id
FROM mapping m
WHERE cv.compose_config_id = m.old_id;

WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
UPDATE lesson l
SET compose_config_id = m.canonical_id
FROM mapping m
WHERE l.compose_config_id = m.old_id;

WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
UPDATE task t
SET compose_config_id = m.canonical_id
FROM mapping m
WHERE t.compose_config_id = m.old_id;

WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
INSERT INTO compose_config_tech (compose_config_id, tech_id)
SELECT m.canonical_id, cct.tech_id
FROM compose_config_tech cct
JOIN mapping m ON cct.compose_config_id = m.old_id
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
DELETE FROM compose_config_tech cct
USING mapping m
WHERE cct.compose_config_id = m.old_id;

WITH canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (config) id AS canonical_id, config
    FROM compose_config
    ORDER BY config, created_at ASC, id ASC
),
mapping AS (
    SELECT c.id AS old_id, canonical.canonical_id
    FROM compose_config c
    JOIN canonical ON c.config = canonical.config
    WHERE c.id <> canonical.canonical_id
)
DELETE FROM compose_config c
USING mapping m
WHERE c.id = m.old_id;

-- Fill missing title/description based on config heuristics.
WITH services AS (
    SELECT
        cc.id,
        svc.key AS service_name,
        NULLIF(svc.value->>'image', '') AS image
    FROM compose_config cc
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(cc.config->'services', '{}'::jsonb)) AS svc(key, value) ON TRUE
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        string_agg(
            CASE
                WHEN image IS NULL OR image = '' THEN service_name
                WHEN service_name IS NULL OR service_name = '' THEN image
                ELSE service_name || ' (' || image || ')'
            END,
            ', ' ORDER BY service_name
        ) AS description
    FROM services
    GROUP BY id
),
computed AS (
    SELECT
        cc.id,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'nginx%') THEN 'nginx'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'alpine%') THEN 'alpine'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'node%') THEN 'node'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'php%') THEN 'php'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'python%') THEN 'python'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'postgres%') THEN 'postgres'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'mysql%') THEN 'mysql'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'redis%') THEN 'redis'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.image ILIKE 'mongo%') THEN 'mongo'
            ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.service_name FROM services s WHERE s.id = cc.id AND s.service_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.service_name LIMIT 1), 'custom')
        END AS title,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(a.description, ''), 'custom compose config') AS description
    FROM compose_config cc
    LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.id = cc.id
)
UPDATE compose_config cc
SET
    title = CASE WHEN cc.title IS NULL OR cc.title = '' THEN c.title ELSE cc.title END,
    description = CASE WHEN cc.description IS NULL OR cc.description = '' THEN c.description ELSE cc.description END
FROM computed c
WHERE cc.id = c.id AND (cc.title IS NULL OR cc.title = '' OR cc.description IS NULL OR cc.description = '');

-- Ensure uniqueness for compose_config config payloads.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_compose_config_config ON compose_config (config);

-- Remove current_version_id from course.
ALTER TABLE course DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_current_version;
ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS current_version_id;

COMMIT;
